property_tests.description: For any commit SHA that causes a cherry-pick conflict, CherryPick always aborts before returning, leaving the repository in a clean state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 10 distinct conflicting commit SHAs by creating a real git repo with diverging changes to the same file on different branches; each SHA is a real commit that conflicts with the current HEAD
property_tests.invariant_check: After CherryPick returns *CherryPickConflictError, assert fileExists(workDir + "/.git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD") == false AND exec("git status --porcelain", workDir) shows no conflict markers

property_tests.description: For any branch that causes a merge conflict, MergeNoFF always aborts before returning, leaving the repository in a clean state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 10 distinct conflicting branch configurations by creating a real git repo with diverging changes to the same file; each branch has a real conflict with the current HEAD
property_tests.invariant_check: After MergeNoFF returns *MergeNoFFConflictError, assert fileExists(workDir + "/.git/MERGE_HEAD") == false AND exec("git status --porcelain", workDir) shows no conflict markers

property_tests.description: IsAncestor exit code discrimination is exhaustive: exit 0 → (true, nil), exit 1 → (false, nil), other → (false, *GitError).
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enumerate all three cases using real git repos: (1) linear history where A precedes B, (2) diverged branches where A is not an ancestor of B, (3) non-existent SHAs that cause git to exit with code > 1
property_tests.invariant_check: For exit 0: result == true AND err == nil; for exit 1: result == false AND err == nil; for other exit: result == false AND err is *GitError with ExitCode != 0 AND ExitCode != 1; no exit code maps to any other combination

property_tests.description: A failure in worktree.Reset after a successful ref update never causes defaultSyncUpdateLocalRefFn to return an error.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enumerate 5 distinct reset failure modes: (1) PlainOpen fails, (2) Worktree() fails, (3) Reset returns I/O error, (4) Reset returns context.Canceled, (5) Reset returns context.DeadlineExceeded — each injected via a mock
property_tests.invariant_check: For each failure mode, assert defaultSyncUpdateLocalRefFn(ctx, repoPath, newHeadSHA) == nil; assert logCapture is non-empty (error was logged)

property_tests.description: All new GitRunner methods return within a bounded time after context cancellation, killing the git subprocess if necessary.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of the 11 new methods (Checkout, CreateBranch, DeleteBranch, CherryPick, ConfigSet, RemoteAdd, Log, Diff, MergeNoFF, MergeAbort, RebaseContinue, IsAncestor), call the method with a pre-cancelled context against a real temp git repo
property_tests.invariant_check: Each method call completes within 2 seconds of context cancellation; assert the returned error is context.Canceled or context.DeadlineExceeded (not a *GitError from a subprocess that ran to completion)

property_tests.description: ConflictingFiles always contains at least one entry for any conflict error returned by CherryPick or MergeNoFF.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample 20 conflict scenarios: 10 where git output contains parseable CONFLICT lines (varying file counts 1-5), 10 where git output contains no CONFLICT lines (binary conflicts, custom merge drivers, empty output)
property_tests.invariant_check: For every returned *CherryPickConflictError or *MergeNoFFConflictError, assert len(err.ConflictingFiles) >= 1; when no CONFLICT lines are present, assert ConflictingFiles == ["(unresolved conflict)"]

property_tests.description: No new GitRunner method calls os.Exit or panics on any recoverable error condition.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of the 11 new methods, exercise all error paths: empty args, non-existent refs, cancelled contexts, git subprocess failures — using real temp git repos and recover() to catch panics
property_tests.invariant_check: For each error path: recover() returns nil (no panic); the process is still running; the returned value is a Go error value (not a process exit); assert no os.Exit is called by wrapping os.Exit in a test stub

smoke_tests.description: CherryPick happy path: a valid commit is applied cleanly and the new HEAD SHA is returned.
smoke_tests.trigger: Call GitRunner.CherryPick(ctx, featureCommitSHA) on a repo where 'main' and 'feature' branches diverge cleanly
expected_effects: CherryPick returns (newHeadSHA, nil) where newHeadSHA is a valid 40-char hex SHA
git rev-parse HEAD in workDir equals newHeadSHA
git log --oneline shows the cherry-picked commit message at HEAD
No CHERRY_PICK_HEAD file exists in .git/

smoke_tests.description: CherryPick conflict path: auto-abort runs and *CherryPickConflictError with ConflictingFiles is returned.
smoke_tests.trigger: Call GitRunner.CherryPick(ctx, conflictingSHA) on a repo where the commit conflicts with the current HEAD
expected_effects: CherryPick returns ("", *CherryPickConflictError)
CherryPickConflictError.ConflictingFiles contains at least one file path
No CHERRY_PICK_HEAD file exists in .git/ (abort succeeded)
git status --porcelain shows clean working tree

smoke_tests.description: MergeNoFF happy path: a clean merge produces a merge commit and the SHA is returned.

expected_effects: MergeNoFF returns (mergeCommitSHA, nil) where mergeCommitSHA is a valid 40-char hex SHA
git rev-parse HEAD in workDir equals mergeCommitSHA
git log --oneline -1 shows a merge commit message
No MERGE_HEAD file exists in .git/

smoke_tests.description: IsAncestor three-way exit code discrimination: all three outcomes (ancestor, not ancestor, error) are correctly mapped.
smoke_tests.trigger: Call GitRunner.IsAncestor with three different input pairs covering exit codes 0, 1, and other
expected_effects: For commitA ancestor of commitB: returns (true, nil)
For commitA not ancestor of commitB: returns (false, nil)
For non-existent SHAs: returns (false, *GitError) with ExitCode != 0 and != 1

smoke_tests.description: Sync fast-forward with working tree reset: on-disk files are updated to match the new HEAD after ref advancement.

expected_effects: defaultSyncUpdateLocalRefFn returns nil
git rev-parse HEAD in the workspace repo equals the new HEAD SHA
